completed_words: Completed patterns name a run of labels over the last few days that the rules count as a finished pattern on the scanned day, such as a 2-2 reversal: two 2 bars in a row pointing opposite ways in their labels.
coverage: 1,809 of the 1,833 names in the Strat Scanner's record were labelled for 2026-11-11 and are grouped here into 317 combinations; 24 had no bar that day and show nothing

label_words.meaning: The day's bar stayed inside the day before: its highest price did not pass the day before's highest, and its lowest price did not pass the day before's lowest.
label_words.name: Inside bar

label_words.label: 2-up
label_words.meaning: The day's bar passed the day before's highest price, but did not pass its lowest price.
label_words.name: Took the high side only

label_words.label: 2-down
label_words.meaning: The day's bar passed the day before's lowest price, but did not pass its highest price.
label_words.name: Took the low side only

label_words.meaning: The day's bar passed both sides of the day before: its highest price passed the day before's highest, and its lowest price passed the day before's lowest. Daily prices alone cannot say which side was passed first, so the label is the plain 3.
label_words.name: Outside bar

note: This board groups the Strat Scanner's labels and adds no labels of its own. Combinations are read as sequences: each group below is the exact run of labels a name showed over the last 5 sessions, named by its last two labels.
proving_note: Still being proven: this scanner's labels have no forward record yet. The labels below name the pattern each name's bars showed on the day; nothing has graded what happened after them, and the page makes no claim about what follows a label.
